message: `peek` calls `memGetWord`, whose safety depends on its caller, and its declaration does not say so
label: a precondition interface
notes: `memGetWord` requires: `addr` names a live block of at least `index` + 1 words. A call to it is safe only when its caller makes that true, which is what `effect(unsafe)` here says this declaration does
help: this fires where the unsafe operation is performed, not up the call chain. The tag alone makes the declaration a trusted encapsulation, whose callers inherit nothing; write `;@axiom:precondition(...)` beside it as well when its safety depends on what its caller passes. If the operation is not wanted here the fix is to stop performing it, not to stop saying so
